leadText:
Claudina (Japanese: トラミ Torami) is a character of the day who appeared in Two Degrees of Separation!.

Claudina is a truck driver who met in Pewter City when he was trying to hitch a ride to Sinnoh. She and Brock encountered when he was traveling on .

Brock was attracted to her and was planning on traveling with her, but all of that changed when he found out she already had a boyfriend. She said goodbye to Brock, thanked him for the lunch and dinner he made for her, and drove off.
